method: behavioural model B (sim/bmodel/model.py: second-order single-bit delaying-integrator loop) loaded with the per-corner T-extracted parameters (sim/bmodel/corners/, one file per DR-002 anchor, every parameter's T record and hash named), swept over 12 amplitudes at N = 2^16 output samples, Blackman-Harris 4-term, coherent tone. klt does not execute this model (executed_by_klt: false on the citation). The rows covered here are configuration the records stamp directly; row 2 (peak SNDR) is deliberately NOT carried: every corner's DR-001 cross-check is incomplete (sim/bmodel/xcheck-record.json), so the B numbers are uncross-checked and the manifest declares row 2 a gap.

measurements.name: band_bw_hz
measurements.what: analysed band of the committed records: 0-20 kHz, DC and tone-lobe bins excluded; set by fout/4 at OSR 128

measurements.name: oversampling_ratio
measurements.what: modulator clock 5.12 MHz, decimation 128 -> fout 40 kSps (fallback row in the spec table); the loop and decimator configuration every committed record stamps
